name: St Joseph's Cathedral
kicker: The twin-tower church at 40 Nha Chung
summary: Stand in the square at 40 Nha Chung, just west of Hoan Kiem, and look up at the two stone towers of St Joseph's, the clock between them, and the statue in front. The facade and the square are the visit, an easy stop on the lake walk. Come back after dark, when the clock is lit.
heroCaption: St Joseph's Cathedral and its two towers
body: The church faces a small square at 40 Nha Chung, west of Hoan Kiem. You see the two stone towers, the clock, and the statue in front. Stand back across the square to get both towers in one frame.

Fit it between the lake and the lanes north of it: the cathedral sits on the west side of that walk. If the doors are shut, the facade and the square are still the visit, and the towers read again after dark with the clock lit.

figures.caption: The same towers after dark, with the clock lit
figures.alt: St Joseph's Cathedral in Hanoi lit at night

gettingThere: Walk west from Hoan Kiem Lake to the square at 40 Nha Chung.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: Walk west from the lake shore to Nha Chung.

hours: Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism alone lists Mon–Sat 8:00–11:00 and 14:00–20:00, Sun 7:00–11:00 and 15:00–21:00; no parish timetable confirms it.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism alone lists free entry.
